en.text: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列众人聚集到希伯 见大卫，说：「我们原是你的骨肉。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列眾人聚集到希伯崙見大衛，說：「我們原是你的骨肉。

en.text: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. The LORD your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”

zhSimplified.text: 从前扫罗作王的时候，率领以色列人出入的是你；耶和华—你的 神也曾应许你说：『你必牧养我的民以色列，作以色列的君。』」

zhTraditional.text: 從前掃羅作王的時候，率領以色列人出入的是你；耶和華－你的上帝也曾應許你說：『你必牧養我的民以色列，作以色列的君。』」

en.text: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. They anointed David king over Israel, according to the LORD’s word by Samuel.

zhSimplified.text: 于是以色列的长老都来到希伯 见大卫王。大卫在希伯 耶和华面前与他们立约，他们就膏大卫作以色列的王，是照耶和华借撒母耳所说的话。

zhTraditional.text: 於是以色列的長老都來到希伯崙見大衛王。大衛在希伯崙耶和華面前與他們立約，他們就膏大衛作以色列的王，是照耶和華藉撒母耳所說的話。

en.text: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫和以色列众人到了耶路撒冷，就是耶布斯；那时耶布斯人住在那里。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛和以色列眾人到了耶路撒冷，就是耶布斯；那時耶布斯人住在那裏。

en.text: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.

zhSimplified.text: 耶布斯人对大卫说：「你决不能进这地方。」然而大卫攻取锡安的保障，就是大卫的城。

zhTraditional.text: 耶布斯人對大衛說：「你決不能進這地方。」然而大衛攻取錫安的保障，就是大衛的城。

en.text: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫说：「谁先攻打耶布斯人，必作首领元帅。」洗鲁雅的儿子约押先上去，就作了元帅。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛說：「誰先攻打耶布斯人，必作首領元帥。」洗魯雅的兒子約押先上去，就作了元帥。

en.text: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫住在保障里，所以那保障叫作大卫城。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛住在保障裏，所以那保障叫作大衛城。

en.text: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫又从米罗起，四围建筑城墙，其余的是约押修理。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛又從米羅起，四圍建築城牆，其餘的是約押修理。

en.text: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD of Armies was with him.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫日见强盛，因为万军之耶和华与他同在。 （撒下23·8—39）

zhTraditional.text: 大衛日見強盛，因為萬軍之耶和華與他同在。 （撒下23‧8－39）

en.text: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the LORD’s word concerning Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 以下记录跟随大卫勇士的首领，就是奋勇帮助他得国、照着耶和华吩咐以色列人的话、与以色列人一同立他作王的。

zhTraditional.text: 以下記錄跟隨大衛勇士的首領，就是奮勇幫助他得國、照着耶和華吩咐以色列人的話、與以色列人一同立他作王的。

en.text: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫勇士的数目记在下面：哈革摩尼的儿子雅朔班，他是军长的统领，一时举枪杀了三百人。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛勇士的數目記在下面：哈革摩尼的兒子雅朔班，他是軍長的統領，一時舉槍殺了三百人。

en.text: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.

zhSimplified.text: 其次是亚合人朵多的儿子以利亚撒，他是三个勇士里的一个。

zhTraditional.text: 其次是亞合人朵多的兒子以利亞撒，他是三個勇士裏的一個。

en.text: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

zhSimplified.text: 他从前与大卫在巴斯·达闵，非利士人聚集要打仗。那里有一块长满大麦的田，众民就在非利士人面前逃跑；

zhTraditional.text: 他從前與大衛在巴斯‧達閔，非利士人聚集要打仗。那裏有一塊長滿大麥的田，眾民就在非利士人面前逃跑；

en.text: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great victory.

zhSimplified.text: 这勇士便站在那田间击杀非利士人，救护了那田。耶和华使以色列人大获全胜。

zhTraditional.text: 這勇士便站在那田間擊殺非利士人，救護了那田。耶和華使以色列人大獲全勝。

en.text: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

zhSimplified.text: 三十个勇士中的三个人下到磐石那里，进了亚杜兰洞见大卫；非利士的军队在利乏音谷安营。

zhTraditional.text: 三十個勇士中的三個人下到磐石那裏，進了亞杜蘭洞見大衛；非利士的軍隊在利乏音谷安營。

en.text: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.

zhSimplified.text: 那时大卫在山寨，非利士人的防营在伯利恒。

zhTraditional.text: 那時大衛在山寨，非利士人的防營在伯利恆。

en.text: David longed, and said, “Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

zhSimplified.text: 大卫渴想，说：「甚愿有人将伯利恒城门旁井里的水打来给我喝！」

zhTraditional.text: 大衛渴想，說：「甚願有人將伯利恆城門旁井裏的水打來給我喝！」

en.text: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to the LORD,

zhSimplified.text: 这三个勇士就闯过非利士人的营盘，从伯利恒城门旁的井里打水，拿来奉给大卫。他却不肯喝，将水奠在耶和华面前，

zhTraditional.text: 這三個勇士就闖過非利士人的營盤，從伯利恆城門旁的井裏打水，拿來奉給大衛。他卻不肯喝，將水奠在耶和華面前，

en.text: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

zhSimplified.text: 说：「我的 神啊，这三个人冒死去打水，这水好像他们的血一般，我断不敢喝！」如此，大卫不肯喝。这是三个勇士所做的事。

zhTraditional.text: 說：「我的上帝啊，這三個人冒死去打水，這水好像他們的血一般，我斷不敢喝！」如此，大衛不肯喝。這是三個勇士所做的事。

en.text: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

zhSimplified.text: 约押的兄弟亚比筛是这三个勇士的首领；他举枪杀了三百人，就在三个勇士里得了名。

zhTraditional.text: 約押的兄弟亞比篩是這三個勇士的首領；他舉槍殺了三百人，就在三個勇士裏得了名。

en.text: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.

zhSimplified.text: 他在这三个勇士里是最尊贵的，所以作他们的首领；只是不及前三个勇士。

zhTraditional.text: 他在這三個勇士裏是最尊貴的，所以作他們的首領；只是不及前三個勇士。

en.text: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.

zhSimplified.text: 有甲薛勇士耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅行过大能的事：他杀了摩押人亚利伊勒的两个儿子，又在下雪的时候下坑里去杀了一个狮子，

zhTraditional.text: 有甲薛勇士耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅行過大能的事：他殺了摩押人亞利伊勒的兩個兒子，又在下雪的時候下坑裏去殺了一個獅子，

en.text: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

footnotes.text: 11:23 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. Therefore this Egyptian was about 7 feet and 6 inches or 2.28 meters tall.

zhSimplified.text: 又杀了一个埃及人。埃及人身高五肘，手里拿着枪，枪杆粗如织布的机轴；比拿雅只拿着棍子下去，从埃及人手里夺过枪来，用那枪将他刺死。

zhTraditional.text: 又殺了一個埃及人。埃及人身高五肘，手裏拿着槍，槍桿粗如織布的機軸；比拿雅只拿着棍子下去，從埃及人手裏奪過槍來，用那槍將他刺死。

en.text: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.

zhSimplified.text: 这是耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅所行的事，就在三个勇士里得了名。

zhTraditional.text: 這是耶何耶大的兒子比拿雅所行的事，就在三個勇士裏得了名。

en.text: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.

zhSimplified.text: 他比那三十个勇士都尊贵，只是不及前三个勇士。大卫立他作护卫长。

zhTraditional.text: 他比那三十個勇士都尊貴，只是不及前三個勇士。大衛立他作護衛長。

en.text: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

zhSimplified.text: 军中的勇士有约押的兄弟亚撒黑，伯利恒人朵多的儿子伊勒哈难，

zhTraditional.text: 軍中的勇士有約押的兄弟亞撒黑，伯利恆人朵多的兒子伊勒哈難，

en.text: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

zhSimplified.text: 哈律人沙玛，比伦人希利斯，

zhTraditional.text: 哈律人沙瑪，比倫人希利斯，

en.text: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

zhSimplified.text: 提哥亚人益吉的儿子以拉，亚拿突人亚比以谢，

zhTraditional.text: 提哥亞人益吉的兒子以拉，亞拿突人亞比以謝，

en.text: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

zhSimplified.text: 户沙人西比该，亚合人以来，

zhTraditional.text: 戶沙人西比該，亞合人以來，

en.text: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

zhSimplified.text: 尼陀法人玛哈莱，尼陀法人巴拿的儿子希立，

zhTraditional.text: 尼陀法人瑪哈萊，尼陀法人巴拿的兒子希立，

en.text: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

zhSimplified.text: 便雅悯族基比亚人利拜的儿子以太，比拉顿人比拿雅，

zhTraditional.text: 便雅憫族基比亞人利拜的兒子以太，比拉頓人比拿雅，

en.text: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

zhSimplified.text: 迦实溪人户莱，亚拉巴人亚比，

zhTraditional.text: 迦實溪人戶萊，亞拉巴人亞比，

en.text: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

zhSimplified.text: 巴路米人押斯玛弗，沙本人以利雅哈巴，

zhTraditional.text: 巴路米人押斯瑪弗，沙本人以利雅哈巴，

en.text: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,

zhSimplified.text: 基孙人哈深的众子，哈拉人沙基的儿子约拿单，

zhTraditional.text: 基孫人哈深的眾子，哈拉人沙基的兒子約拿單，

en.text: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

zhSimplified.text: 哈拉人沙甲的儿子亚希暗，吾珥的儿子以利法勒，

zhTraditional.text: 哈拉人沙甲的兒子亞希暗，吾珥的兒子以利法勒，

en.text: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

zhSimplified.text: 米基拉人希弗，比伦人亚希雅，

zhTraditional.text: 米基拉人希弗，比倫人亞希雅，

en.text: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

zhSimplified.text: 迦密人希斯罗，伊斯拜的儿子拿莱，

zhTraditional.text: 迦密人希斯羅，伊斯拜的兒子拿萊，

en.text: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,

zhSimplified.text: 拿单的兄弟约珥，哈基利的儿子弥伯哈，

zhTraditional.text: 拿單的兄弟約珥，哈基利的兒子彌伯哈，

en.text: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),

zhSimplified.text: 亚扪人洗勒，比录人拿哈莱（拿哈莱是给洗鲁雅的儿子约押拿兵器的），

zhTraditional.text: 亞捫人洗勒，比錄人拿哈萊（拿哈萊是給洗魯雅的兒子約押拿兵器的），

en.text: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

zhSimplified.text: 以帖人以拉，以帖人迦立，

zhTraditional.text: 以帖人以拉，以帖人迦立，

en.text: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

zhSimplified.text: 赫人乌利亚，亚莱的儿子撒拔，

zhTraditional.text: 赫人烏利亞，亞萊的兒子撒拔，

en.text: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,

zhSimplified.text: 吕便人示撒的儿子亚第拿（他是吕便支派中的一个族长，率领三十人），

zhTraditional.text: 呂便人示撒的兒子亞第拿（他是呂便支派中的一個族長，率領三十人），

en.text: Hanan the son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,

zhSimplified.text: 玛迦的儿子哈难，弥特尼人约沙法，

zhTraditional.text: 瑪迦的兒子哈難，彌特尼人約沙法，

en.text: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

zhSimplified.text: 亚施他拉人乌西亚，亚罗珥人何坦的儿子沙玛、耶利，

zhTraditional.text: 亞施他拉人烏西亞，亞羅珥人何坦的兒子沙瑪、耶利，

en.text: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

zhSimplified.text: 提洗人申利的儿子耶叠和他的兄弟约哈，

zhTraditional.text: 提洗人申利的兒子耶疊和他的兄弟約哈，

en.text: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

zhSimplified.text: 玛哈未人以利业，伊利拿安的儿子耶利拜、约沙未雅，摩押人伊特玛、

zhTraditional.text: 瑪哈未人以利業，伊利拿安的兒子耶利拜、約沙未雅，摩押人伊特瑪、

en.text: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

zhSimplified.text: 以利业、俄备得，并米琐八人雅西业。

zhTraditional.text: 以利業、俄備得，並米瑣八人雅西業。
